Rumors have suggested that Apple has been working on a major revamp of its Home lineup, and a new leak has now laid out a list of what to expect.

macOS Code Leak Mentions Multiple Unreleased Home Devices

Apple's biggest launch event of the year is just weeks away, and it's expected to bring the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, a new Apple Watch lineup, and several new Home products.

Rumors suggest a new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad are all on the way. There are also several other Home products that could arrive soon.

MacRumors discovered yesterday that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC version references a number of unannounced products.

Among them are codenames related to Home devices. Quoting Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is said to be a tabletop version with a dock, while J491 is a wall-mountable version."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The HomePod mini is codenamed B520, so B525 is likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Most likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Newly mentioned, unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: A new generation Siri Remote to pair with the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a tabletop robotic-style home hub. It's unclear whether their codenames appear in the macOS 26.7 leaks.

Beyond products, MacRumors also found a reference to "Pebble," believed to be the codename for homeOS. There is also a string called "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning," which may be related to HomePad.

Finally, the leak surfaced four colors for an unspecified Home accessory: Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.
